Walmart's net margin in fiscal Q2 2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) was about 3.4%.

- Net income attributable to Walmart was about $6.37 billion. This is from an IndexBox summary of the results, not the earnings release itself.
- Total revenues were $187.94 billion.
- Margin = 6.37 / 187.94 ≈ 3.39%.

If you use consolidated net income of $6.529 billion, which includes noncontrolling interests, the margin is about 3.47%. I used the figure attributable to Walmart because that is the usual basis for net margin.
